description: Expected results for PorePy's official Mandel problem (src/porepy/examples/mandel_biot.py, Biot poromechanics on a 2D Cartesian grid) as run by PorePy's own functional test tests/functional/test_mandel.py. Values are the relative/absolute errors against the exact analytical Mandel solution.

numeric_checks.name: n_results
numeric_checks.why: errors saved at both requested times (25 s and 50 s)

numeric_checks.name: final_time
numeric_checks.why: simulation reached the end time 50 s

numeric_checks.name: error_pressure_t25
numeric_checks.why: relative L2 error of pressure vs the exact Mandel solution at t=25 s; official desired value and tolerance from tests/functional/test_mandel.py

numeric_checks.name: error_flux_t25

numeric_checks.name: scaled_minus_unscaled_error_pressure
numeric_checks.why: pressure error must be the same for scaled (mm, g) and unscaled runs; official check assert_almost_equal(decimal=4) in test_scaled_vs_unscaled_systems

numeric_checks.name: scaled_minus_unscaled_error_displacement
numeric_checks.why: displacement error must be the same for scaled (mm, g) and unscaled runs; official check assert_almost_equal(decimal=4) in test_scaled_vs_unscaled_systems

tolerance_rule: pass if |got - expected| <= atol + rtol*|expected| (same as numpy.testing.assert_allclose used by the official test)
recorded_with: /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/PorePy/venv/bin/python (porepy 1.12.0 editable install of the repo), OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
reference: OFFICIAL: the expected error values and tolerances (atol 1e-5, rtol 1e-3; decimal=4 for scaled vs unscaled) are copied from tests/functional/test_mandel.py of pmgbergen/porepy at the commit above. run_reference.py also re-reads them from inputs/test_mandel.py and fails if they differ.
notes: pytest is not installed in the engine venv, so run_reference.py drives the same model setup as the test fixture with a small script. No input file is changed.
